problems.note: The recorded null fails the permitted se_basis vocabulary in extraction-spec.md. The paper prints a permutation p-value and confidence interval but does not identify the permutation/resampling unit or explain how pairs sharing participants enter the uncertainty calculation. Consequently, the paper does not establish participant, output, pair, or set as the uncertainty basis. The pairwise outcome unit alone is not evidence that pairs were treated as independent. not_reported would also contradict the field definition, which reserves that code for contrasts with no printed uncertainty. The printed value is null here because no replacement basis can be confirmed; this is an unresolved codebook/schema gap, not a numerical transcription error. Resolve how to encode reported uncertainty with an unspecified basis without guessing a sampling unit or discarding the printed uncertainty.

summary: Checked the ten requested estimates after reading the entire markdown conversion, including Appendices A-E and references, and extracting the cited PDF pages 8, 9, 10, 11 and 18. All recorded numerical statistics and participant counts match the correct outcomes, studies and arms. Study 1 uses 45 participants per arm (90 total); Study 2 uses 59 assisted and 58 control participants (117 total). The nine reported quote-not-found warnings are false positives: the Study 1 permutation quote matches after removing a soft hyphen and its line break within difference; all eight Appendix D quotes match after removing zero-width characters in empty table cells and normalizing whitespace. All 30 source quotes match their exact cited pages after this normalization. Question, construct, measure, unit, direction, AI availability, timing, within-person coding and comparison type are supported. Appendix D explicitly aggregates expert ratings to participant-level measures; its eight descriptive estimates correctly retain not_reported for se_basis because no contrast uncertainty is printed. The only remaining problems are the two invalid null se_basis codes. The paper cannot establish an allowed replacement, and not_reported would misdescribe its reported permutation uncertainty. No additional identifiable in-scope outcome or full-sample contrast was found under rules 4-6. Breadth and depth records are already present. Model-only stimulus comparisons, manipulation-check subgroups and cross-study differences do not add eligible contrasts. The shorter-ideas remark on PDF p. 19 supplies no identified study-specific length measure or analysis and is documented in not_extracted. No effect, uncertainty or missing count was derived; only this re-verification report was written.
